subsystem: complex numeric arithmetic and coordinate conversion
implementation: Readable high-level C99 formulas using canonical ten-byte scalar records; no original firmware execution or host floating-point arithmetic

implemented_routines.name: scalar sign and domain classification
implemented_routines.scope: Native zero/negative/positive/domain classes, classification before metadata clearing and compact cancellation remaining positive rather than zero

implemented_routines.name: complex addition
implemented_routines.scope: Component addition with real header40 normalization; twenty-byte error normalization

implemented_routines.name: complex subtraction
implemented_routines.scope: Negated right components before addition, retaining original scalar order

implemented_routines.name: complex multiplication
implemented_routines.scope: Imaginary component before real component, scalar exact/fallback arithmetic

implemented_routines.name: complex division
implemented_routines.scope: Three axis-specific branches and ordered generic denominator/numerators; component integer-ratio rational reconstruction

implemented_routines.name: restricted complex powers
implemented_routines.scope: Reciprocal, square, cube and the native selector rejecting all other exponent records

implemented_routines.name: conjugate, negate and component cleanup
implemented_routines.scope: Canonical decimal/rational/surd/error pairs, exact early-error policy including zero-code F0 continuation, original component order and prepared native return status

implemented_routines.name: complex magnitude
implemented_routines.scope: Both safe-square and ratio-scaling branches, short exact-root recognition, zero and error components

implemented_routines.name: restricted complex square root
implemented_routines.scope: Zero imaginary admission, real surd conversion, classification before marker clearing and positive imaginary roots for negative real values

implemented_routines.name: display-precision rounding
implemented_routines.scope: Norm/Sci/Fix scalar rounding, exact integral Fix short circuit, imaginary-first complex wrapper and separate native firmware return status

implemented_routines.name: complex argument
implemented_routines.scope: Decimal atan2 in degree/radian/grad units, mandatory y/x truncation before reciprocal, quadrant and signed-zero branches

implemented_routines.name: polar and rectangular conversion
implemented_routines.scope: Full twenty-byte numeric outputs including exact trigonometric special results, magnitude, argument, source aliases, dual F3 errors and successful axis angles with rejected F3 radius
